rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING COMPULSORY COVERAGE TO ACCREDITED BARANGAY HEALTH WORKERS IN THE NATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE PROGRAM, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7883 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Granting Compulsory Coverage To Accredited Barangay Health Workers In The National Health Insurance Program
rows.abstract: Directs the enrollment of all barangay health workers (BHWs) and their dependents in the National health Insurance Program (Philhealth). The monthly minimum contribution of BHWs in 4th, 5th and 6th class municipalities shall be shared by the national government and the local government unit.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2008-10-09, transmitted to on 2008-10-14 and received by the Senate on 2008-10-14

second_reading.remarks: On Sept. 16, 2008, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure; terminated the period of sponsorship and debate; terminated the period of amendments and approved the same on Second Reading.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE CREATION OF INDEBTEDNESS BY LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS WHOSE HEAD IS ON HIS/HER THIRD TERM OF OFFICE AND AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Aims to prohibit local government units (LGUs) from acquiring loans, credits and other forms of indebtedness when the LGU head is on his/her third term unless the loan's repayment scheme ensures that the loan shall be paid off before the end of the term of the LGU head.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2008-09-01
